description: This source file defines Express route handlers related to user progress tracking in an LMS platform. It includes routes for updating course progress and marking modules as complete, utilizing database operations for persisting progress data.

methods.name: POST /progress
methods.description: Handles recording course progress for a user, inserting or ignoring enrollment records.

methods.name: PATCH /modules/:id/complete
methods.description: Marks a specific module as completed for the current user, updating or inserting progress records.
